- Netherlands achieved exceptional growth with revenue up 1006.9% WoW to £10.4k TW and 465.4% YoY, now representing 6.6% of total sales.
- Germany revenue decreased 21.9% WoW to £3.2k TW but grew 191.5% YoY, with 12 orders placed TW.
- United Kingdom processed 315 orders TW generating 71,925 units, while Netherlands completed orders for 5,624 units TW.
- France recorded 1,911 units across 8 orders TW with 120.7% YoY revenue growth.
- Total revenue increased 4.9% YoY to £157.1k TW compared to £149.9k LY, despite the significant weekly decline.
